scope: finite digital schedule, protocol and queue contract; target implementation and physical behavior unearned

raw_ADC.priming: MAN_CH0 frame discarded before acquisition; read back range/configuration; new epoch after reset or lost transaction
raw_ADC.missed_or_unknown_transaction_action: invalidate epoch and all affected samples; stop new dose admission; reset/readback/prime before explicit rearm

resources.queue_full_action: stop diagnostic capture, retain gap/overrun metadata; never overwrite as valid

main_project.motor: expert-informed learner-specific policy; OFF retained learning is a separate conditional biological hypothesis
main_project.physiology: target-specific pressure feedback; external measured SBP, finite pressor authority and fallback variants
